name: evens-enc-packer
description: Builds content/enc from the matesspace.h1n.ru course. Dev-machine only — nothing here ships to the phone or the glasses.
comment: sharp, marked and mathjax-full are NOT listed: this imports ../../server/render/tiles.ts, and module resolution starts from that file, so those come from server/node_modules and the packer can never render with a different version than the server does. playwright is here because dom.ts imports it directly. Browser binaries are shared out of ~/.cache/ms-playwright.
